sources.citation: docs/victron-ble-extra-manufacturer-data-2022-12-14.pdf — Victron wiki page "Extra manufacturer Data", printed 2022-12-14. Committed. Record-type table and the (Lynx Smart) BMS record layout, pp. 1 and 6–7.

transport: Same BLE container as record 0x02 — Victron manufacturer data type 0x10, extra-manufacturer-data record from byte 8, AES-CTR with the 2-byte header nonce, per-device 16-byte key required. Record type 0x0A.
blocks: Record type 0x0A, "(Lynx Smart) BMS". Bit offsets transcribed from the committed PDF: 32/8 Error, NA 0x0 (VE_REG_BMS_ERROR) · 40/16 TTG, 1 min, 0..45.5 days, NA 0xFFFF (VE_REG_TTG) · 56/16 Battery voltage, 0.01 V, -327.68..327.66 V, NA 0x7FFF (VE_REG_DC_CHANNEL1_VOLTAGE) · 72/16 Battery current, 0.1 A, -3276.8..3276.6, NA 0x7FFF (VE_REG_DC_CHANNEL1_CURRENT) · 88/16 IO status, NA 0x0 (VE_REG_BMS_IO) · 104/18 Warnings/Alarms, NA 0x0 (VE_REG_BMS_WARNINGS_ALARMS) · 122/10 SOC, 0.1 %, 0..100.0 %, NA 0x3FF (VE_REG_SOC) · 132/20 Consumed Ah, 0.1 Ah, -104857..0 Ah, NA 0xFFFFF (VE_REG_CAH) · 152/7 Temperature, °C, -40..86 °C, NA 0x7F (VE_REG_BAT_TEMPERATURE) · 159/1 unused.
gotchas: The models list is empty and that is the honest answer. The record type is named "(Lynx Smart) BMS" — the only place in this document where a record name contains a Victron product line, which is weak but real evidence — yet no part number, no model number and no firmware minimum appears anywhere in it. The Quebec list

Different bit layout from record 0x02, not a variant of it. Every field after the header sits at a different offset — TTG at 40 not 32, battery voltage at 56 not 48, SOC at 122 not 140. A shared decoder that keys on record type is fine; one that assumes battery monitors are battery monitors is not.
Battery current here is 0.1 A signed 16-bit. In record 0x02 it is 0.001 A over 22 bits. Same quantity, two encodings, one document.

Temperature here is degrees C with a -40 offset — vendor remark: "Temperature = Record value - 40", 7 bits, range -40..86 °C. Record 0x02 uses 0.01 K over 16 bits. Three temperature encodings now exist across Victron transports (0.01 K over HEX, 0.01 K over BLE 0x02, °C-minus-40 over BLE 0x0A).
Consumed Ah is sign-inverted here too: "Consumed Ah = -Record value".
unmappedReports: Error at bit 32 (VE_REG_BMS_ERROR) — no fault-code MetricKind., IO status at bit 88, 16 bits (VE_REG_BMS_IO) — no metric. This is where allowed-to-charge / allowed-to-discharge / contactor state live on a BMS, and they are the difference between a healthy bank and a disconnected one., Warnings/Alarms at bit 104, 18 bits (VE_REG_BMS_WARNINGS_ALARMS) — no metric., The record carries no state-of-health, no cell voltages and no cell balance, so nothing is lost there — but note that `state-of-health` exists in MetricKind and this record cannot fill it.
